notesForTheArchitect: Round sixteen missed this round's defect and the miss has a clean rule: when the base moves a file, check both the content that moved and every sentence that names where it was. I checked the first and not the second.

The skills guard cannot catch a sentence like this one, measured both ways rather than argued: a missing target fails it by name, and a true-file-wrong-claim passes it. Anything that wants to catch the second is reading prose, not links - which is the instruction-then-cross-review-then-gate order the deployment instructions set, and the cross-review is what caught it here.
